Accessible Holidays

Youth Hostel Mittenwald

Content on this page

  • Address & contact

Description

A sky full of violins above the Karwendel massif

The view sweeps over a splendour of flowers on hummocky meadows: Lady's slipper, gentian and alpine rose are all aglow. Zugspitze and Karwendel make this idyll perfect. Mittenwald, the highest climatic health resort in the Bavarian Alps, means relaxation for body and soul. Just 4 kilometres from Mittenwald you will find our Ganghofer Youth Hostel with 110 beds. We are the ideal starting point for discovering the breathtaking landscape. With our diverse range of activities, we are also an "Alpine Study Site".  You will learn to understand and love nature during our educationally guided adventure programmes.

Information on accessibility

Download short report as PDF
People with walking difficulties and wheelchair users

Some information on accessibility are listed below. For detailed information please see the evaluation report.

  • A parking space for people with disabilities is available. 
  • The main entrance is accessible without steps via a 6-meter-long outdoor ramp with a 16% grade (door threshold: 2.5 cm); the side entrance is accessible via a 1-meter-long indoor ramp with a 6% grade (door threshold: 3 cm). There are no handrails.
  • From the side entrance, the ground floor is accessible only via stairs.
  • The ground floor houses the raised rooms, the dining room, and the public restroom; the upper floor houses the lounge and the conference room; and the lower level houses the table tennis room, another lounge, and the sauna area. The lower and upper floors are accessible only via stairs with handrails.
  • The reception desk is 104 cm high. There is a way to communicate while seated.
  • Doors and passageways are at least 80 cm wide (exceptions: Room 14 at 68 cm, bathrooms in Rooms 11 and 14 at 56 cm, in the sauna area ranging from 50 cm to 68 cm, and in the public restroom at 50 cm).
  • There are no rooms designed to be accessible (limited manoeuvring spaces, no grab bars, etc.).
  • There are no restrooms designed to be accessible.
  • The dining room has tables that are a maximum of 80 cm high and are wheelchair compatible, with a clearance of 67 cm in height and 30 cm in depth.
  • There is no public restroom for people with disabilities.
Test report - Walking disabilities
Test report - Wheelchair
People with visual impairments and blind people

Some information on accessibility are listed below. For detailed information please see the evaluation report.

  • Assistance dogs may be brought along.
  • The main and side entrances are visually contrasted with their surroundings and can be recognized by a tactile change of floor covering.
  • Glass doors are not marked with safety markings.
  • On the ground floor there are the evaluated rooms, the dining room and the public WC; on the first floor there are the lounge and the conference room as well as on the ground floor the table tennis room, a further lounge and the sauna area. The basement and the upper floor can only be reached via stairs.
  • Indoor and outdoor staircases do not have high-contrast step surfaces. Handrails are mostly available.
  • There are no obstacles, e.g. objects protruding into the path / room.
  • Information is available in easily legible font, but not in Braille or prism font.
  • All areas surveyed and usable by the guest are brightly lit and glare-free.
  • Operating elements can be detected tactilely everywhere and are predominantly visually high-contrast.
  • Walkways are visually contrasted everywhere and marked with tactile markings almost everywhere or the walls can be used as orientation guidelines.
  • An uninterrupted guidance system (e.g. ground indicators) is not available.
Test report
People with hearing impairments and deaf people

Some information on accessibility are listed below. For detailed information please see the evaluation report.

  • There is no visual alarm in the building.
  • An inductive hearing system is not available.
  • There are bright and glare-free tables in the dining room where there are no lamps standing or hanging to restrict the field of vision. There are no seating areas with low ambient noise.
  • In room 11 at least one freely available electrical outlet is available near the bed, in room 14 no.
  • Information is available in written form.
Test report
People with cognitive impairments

Some information on accessibility are listed below. For detailed information please see the evaluation report.

  • The name of the company are clearly visible from the outside at the main and side entrances.
  • There is no information in easy language.
  • Information is not displayed with pictograms or images.
  • There is no coloured or pictorial control system available.
  • The objectives of the paths are usually within sight. An uninterrupted guidance system is only partially available.
Test report
Certified in the period: July 2026 – June 2029

Der Inhalt wird dir nicht angezeigt?

Zum Schutz deiner Daten setzen wir eine sog. Zwei-Klick-Lösung ein. Die Cookies von YouTube und Google Maps sind bei uns standardmäßig deaktiviert und werden erst nach dem Klick auf die Schaltfläche „Akzeptieren“ von den jeweiligen Servern geladen. Danach kannst du die Inhalte sehen. Mit dem Klick willigst du ein, dass deine IP-Adresse an YouTube bzw. Google Maps übertragen wird, und dass der Anbieter Cookies in deinem Browser setzt. Für deinen Komfort merken wir uns deine Einwilligung für 1 Jahr über ein sog. Local Storage Objekt, das wir in deinem Browser speichern. Natürlich kannst du diese auch selbstständig in deinen Browser-Einstellugen entfernen, wenn du das nicht möchtest. Mehr Informationen darüber findest du in unseren Datenschutzhinweisen.
